definition: Tal Arbel is a professor of electrical engineering at McGill University who specialises in computer vision.
details: She is interested in the application of artificial intelligence in healthcare.

explainer.lead: Tal Arbel is a Professor of Electrical Engineering.

contributions.name: After completing her PhD, Arbel worked at the Montreal Neurological Hospital, where she developed computer vision methods for neurology and neurosurgery.
At McGill, Arbel leads the Probabilistic Vision Group, which is part of the Centre for Intelligent Machines.
She created an Adaptive Multi-level Conditional Random Field (AMCRF) framework that can leverage spatial and temporal information.
In an effort for to understand brain morphometry, Arbel has developed models for computational neuroanatomy.

timeline.what: She completed her Bachelor's (1992), Master's (1995) and PhD (2000) at McGill University.
She was appointed to McGill University as a Research associate in 2000 and made an assistant professor in 2001.
